title: Bob Deleted The Password
story: Bob 'cleaned up' the server this morning.
The admin password file is gone. Bob says it was 'for security'.
Bob also says the cloud is 'just a really big computer in the sky'.
Nobody ever really deletes anything. Especially not Bob.
objective: Recover the admin password and submit it.

/home/bob/trash/old_sandwich.txt: It's a sandwich. It has been here since March.
It is load-bearing now. Do not move it.
files./home/bob/photos/cat.txt: A photo of a cat sitting on a keyboard. Explains a lot about our codebase.

hints: Bob's todo list is surprisingly honest about what he did and didn't do.
Deleted things often go somewhere before they are truly gone.
Try: ls trash   then   cat trash/admin_password.txt
completion: Bob has been gently reminded that 'trash' is a folder, not a black hole.
He nodded. He did not understand.
